objectives.title: Capture the Temples
objectives.description: Temples will periodically activate. Stand within their grounds to capture their power!

objectives.title: Hold the Temples
objectives.description: Stand firm and the Temple will unleash a blistering onslaught on your enemy's Structures!

objectives.title: Defend the Temples
objectives.description: Guardians will try to wrest control of their Temples from your team. Hold them off to keep the Temple's power for yourselves!
